span.p: 15 @EventListener ApplicationReadyEvent beans. No @Order and no @DependsOn, so relative run order is unspecified and every one is written to be idempotent

span.p: PostgreSQL via org.postgresql.Driver, spring.datasource.url

div.style: color: rgb(30, 58, 41) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Context refresh, Hibernate ddl-auto=update: creates and ALTERs tables, but never refreshes a CHECK constraint it already emitted

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Rest of the refresh: CacheConfig 15 Caffeine caches, SecurityConfig chain, AppConfig BCrypt plus DaoAuthenticationProvider, AsyncConfig trendingLogExecutor

div.style: color: rgb(74, 58, 18) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: app.seed.load is true?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: SeedDataLoader CommandLineRunner: no app.seed.dir on disk means log.warn and return, otherwise read JSON in FK order categories, persons, projects, audios, videos, texts, images. Rows whose business code already exists are skipped

div.style: color: rgb(74, 58, 18) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: ApplicationReadyEvent published, after the runners

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Index creation
MediaSearchIndexInitializer: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pg_trgm, then GIN gin_trgm_ops plus btree text_pattern_ops per searchable column. If the extension statement fails it returns and skips all its own remaining work
PersonSearchIndexInitializer, CategorySearchIndexInitializer: pg_trgm GIN only
AuditLogIndexInitializer: 3 btree indexes, actor_username plus occurred_at, occurred_at, action plus occurred_at, on each of 11 audit_logs tables

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
CHECK re-sync from the live Java enum
SELECT conname FROM pg_constraint for that table and column, DROP each, then ADD CONSTRAINT with the current values
UserRoleConstraintInitializer, UserAuditActionConstraintInitializer, AnalyticsAuditActionConstraintInitializer, MaqamAuditActionConstraintInitializer, GuestCorrectionAuditActionConstraintInitializer, PhysicalMediaAuditActionConstraintInitializer, PhysicalMediaDigitizationConstraintInitializer, whose CHECK also allows NULL

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Stale CHECK dropped outright, no replacement
MediaSearchIndexInitializer: image, text, video, audio and project _audit_logs_action_check
PersonSearchIndexInitializer: person_audit_logs_action_check
CategorySearchIndexInitializer: category_audit_logs_action_check
the Java enum keeps enforcing valid values

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Column migration and backfill
PhysicalMediaSizeColumnMigrationInitializer: returns unless information_schema shows both size and physical_size, then UPDATE physical_media SET physical_size = size WHERE physical_size IS NULL AND size IS NOT NULL
MediaSearchIndexInitializer: SET version = 0 WHERE version IS NULL on audios, videos, images, texts, projects, person, categories

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Catalog seed and permission backfill
PhysicalMediaTypeSeeder: for each of 6 catalog types, save only when existsByName is false, stamped system-seed. Edited rows are left alone
EmployeePhysicalMediaPermissionBackfillInitializer, 4 perms, and EmployeeMaqamTeacherManageBackfillInitializer, 1 perm: INSERT INTO user_permissions SELECT user_id FROM users_tbl WHERE role = EMPLOYEE, ON CONFLICT ON CONSTRAINT uk_user_permissions_user_perm DO NOTHING

div.style: color: rgb(74, 58, 18) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: statement threw?

div.style: color: rgb(90, 50, 16) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: log.warn and carry on: a missing table or column on first boot never aborts startup

div.style: color: rgb(92, 32, 24) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: PhysicalMediaTypeSeeder is the one initializer with no try/catch, so its exception propagates out of the ApplicationReadyEvent publication and fails the run

div.style: color: rgb(30, 58, 41) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Ready to serve on server.port, PORT or 8080
